items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: last time I saw him he was playing with J. C. Heard’s band.

ctx.x: Earl Van Dyke, a pianist in the Earl Hines tradition who played -- last time I saw him he was playing with J. C. Heard’s band.
J.C. Heard, was he around then?
No, he’d left. He was working with Cab Calloway or somebody. I can’t remember with whom he was playing, but he had left.
